title: STAGE-03 | SPEC | P1: write spec
purpose: Turn the accepted request into a testable feature specification, using the official Spec Kit specification skills only.
problem_statement: The request arrived in Portuguese as an informal issue. The factory needs an English specification with testable requirements, acceptance scenarios and no hidden architecture decisions before any design work starts.

inputs.name: normalized-request
inputs.description: The normalized English request produced by intake, with the original text kept separately.

inputs.name: repository-map
inputs.description: The repository map from repository intelligence: languages, build commands, protected paths and existing documentation.

preconditions.description: The intake stage run passed and the request was accepted.
The specify command line tool is installed at the pinned version and the agent integration is initialized.

risk.rationale: A small, additive command line option with no data migration and no security-sensitive behavior.

methods.name: Spec Kit specify, clarify and checklist skills
methods.rationale: The master requirement makes Spec Kit the only framework for this stage. The skills produce the canonical spec.md and a requirements checklist that the adapter can hash and parse.

alternatives_considered.name: A generic specification-writing agent
alternatives_considered.why_not: It would bypass Spec Kit, which the requirement forbids, and would produce a format no other tool understands.

alternatives_considered.name: Running the full Spec Kit workflow
alternatives_considered.why_not: The plan, tasks and implement steps belong to the factory's own stages and are never invoked.

methods.escalation_trigger: Ask a human when the specification still contains a clarification marker after two clarification rounds.

deliverables.name: specification-contract
deliverables.description: The typed specification contract extracted from the Spec Kit files.

deliverables.name: spec-kit-files
deliverables.description: The original spec.md and checklist files, unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.description: The extracted contract validates against the specification contract schema.
No blocking open question remains unanswered.
An independent reviewer finds the requirements testable and unambiguous.

confidence.notes: The request is short and clear, but it came from an informal issue and was translated, so wording may need one clarification round.

assumptions.statement: All requirement text is written in English even though the request was Portuguese.

idempotency.key_scheme: stage_run_id plus the hashes of all input artifacts

escalation.rollback: Delete the specs directory created in the job worktree. Nothing outside the worktree is changed.
